rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A read-only PostgreSQL query server for Claude Desktop that provides secure, validated database access through the MCP protocol. Implements strict query validation to prevent write operations, includes a 10-second timeout mechanism, and allows users to execute SELECT queries against configured PostgreSQL databases by passing a connection string directly via command line arguments.
